comparability.note: This protocol pins the parity-v2 matrix: the same two models, generation controls, prompt version names, version 8 suite, five trials, final run kind, and clean-tag source convention. It cannot pin the parity-v2 bytes. Since tag parity-v2-source-20260904, the version 8 suite file, both corpus fixtures, and briefing-runner-prompt.md changed bytes (schema v7 metadata refresh and runner prompt revisions), and this file's own SHA-256 differs from parity-v1.json. evaluator/regression-policy.json requires same_suite_sha256, same_corpus_sha256, same_protocol_sha256, and shared_prompt_versions_have_same_sha256, so `evaluator compare` against the parity-v2 bundle must run with --allow-descriptive and will record the same descriptive-only outcome parity v2 recorded against parity v1. The gate-eligible comparison this protocol does support is the within-run prompt comparison (production-runner versus runner-deepseek-v4-flash in one matrix) and any later rerun that reuses this exact protocol, suite, corpus, and prompt bytes.

provider_schema.known_asymmetry: tencent/hy3 answers the selection schema with uniqueItems removed, as in parity v1 and v2; its utility and attack rates are not cell-for-cell comparable with deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash and must be reported with this note.

controls.seed_note: The production-parity path rejects --seed; sampling determinism rests on temperature 0 alone. Execution ordering is seeded with --execution-seed 20260901, the parity-v2 value, and recorded in the manifest.

objective: Rerun the parity-v2 generation matrix on the production-parity two-pass path at the current source revision, so the repository has a current-revision generation measurement paired descriptively against the frozen parity-v2 bundle. Parity v2 remains the citable prior baseline; its rows are never pooled with this run.

source.required_tag_note: Replace YYYYMMDD with the UTC date of the frozen commit when this protocol is frozen, following parity-v1-source-20260901c and parity-v2-source-20260904. The tag must point at the clean HEAD that `evaluator run --run-kind final` records.

status_note: Hashes above are the committed bytes at the revision that introduced this file. Before the run: re-hash every listed input and prompt, set frozen_at and authorization.authorized_at, replace required_tag, set status to frozen_for_run, commit, then tag. evaluator/tests/test_protocols.py fails when the listed hashes drift from the committed fixtures.

suite.version_note: Version 8 is pinned because it is the parity-v2 suite; its selection-promotion oracle and scarcity case keep their parity-v2 interpretation. The active default suite is version 9 (generation-cases-v9.json); a version 9 rerun would be a different experiment with different oracles and is not this protocol.
